_doc: Cross-language drift guard for the estate's TITLE/KEY functions (normalization item 1). These produce PERSISTED keys — library_catalog's work.work_key and Firestore review document ids — so drift here silently orphans reviews or mis-links books, the same class of bug §2.3 of PLATFORM.md already recorded once (resolve_author_link / _resolveAuthorFolder). One fixture file, N hand-ported implementations across 2 repos and 2 languages; each repo's CI runs it against its OWN implementation and asserts every case reproduces. The UNIVERSES mechanism, applied to a second contract.
_measured: Every 'expect' value below was produced by executing library_catalog packages/core/src/titles.ts and packages/core/src/reviews.ts on 2026-08-14 (npx tsx against the real source, not hand-computed) — that file is the canon for every function except bookIdFromTitle, whose canon is audiobook_catalog/site/reviews.js; the two are verified byte-identical in source and produce the same values, so the TS run stands in for both. If a case here looks wrong, the fix is a MIGRATION in whichever repo stores the affected key, never an edit to this file to match a new implementation.
_critical: bookIdFromTitle and normaliseTitle intentionally DISAGREE on leading articles: bookIdFromTitle KEEPS 'The'/'A'/'An' (it is ported verbatim from the audiobook site's Firestore review doc-id slug, and changing it orphans every existing review), normaliseTitle STRIPS it (it feeds work_key, a fold, not a slug). This file records EXPECTED OUTPUT PER FUNCTION and never assumes any two functions agree with each other, even on the same input.

normaliseTitle: audiobook_catalog app/library_link.py — imports review_join.normalise_title directly (no third copy)
bookIdFromTitle: audiobook_catalog site/reviews.js — bookIdFromTitle (canon: every existing Firestore review doc id was built with this exact function)
library_catalog packages/core/src/reviews.ts — bookIdFromTitle (ported verbatim, per that file's own header)
audiobook_catalog app/tools/import_pagebound_reviews.py — book_id (a second, independent Python port of the same JS; test_review_join.py already pins the two Python copies against each other)
splitSeriesPrefix: library_catalog packages/core/src/titles.ts — splitSeriesPrefix. No audiobook port exists (audiobook_catalog has no OPF/series-prefix ingest path); included here as a single-repo pin so a future port has a fixture to run against from day one, not written after the fact.

_runners: library_catalog — npm test (packages/core/test/title-key-fixtures.test.ts, file materialised into packages/universes/generated/ by scripts/sync-universes.mjs, same mechanism as match-fold.fixtures.json)

audiobook_catalog — python -m pytest tests/test_title_key_fixtures.py (reads catalog-platform/data/ directly, same posture as tests/test_universes.py: SKIPPED, not failed, when the sibling checkout is absent)
audiobook_catalog — npm test / vitest (site/__tests__/reviews-fixtures.test.js, bookIdFromTitle only — the ONE function whose canon lives in this repo's own site JS)
